items.title: Oklahoma pharmacies due payouts in CVS Caremark settlement - Tulsa World
items.reason: This reports a settlement involving CVS Caremark (a major pharmacy benefit manager functioning as a payer intermediary), with direct financial implications for healthcare providers (pharmacies), fitting the enforcement/settlement category of the topic.
items.summary: Oklahoma pharmacies are receiving payouts through a settlement with CVS Caremark, a major pharmacy benefit manager. While the excerpt does not specify the settlement amount, effective date, or underlying claims, the resolution involves financial compensation to in-state pharmacy providers. This settlement is relevant to revenue-cycle teams because PBM payment disputes and enforcement actions can affect reimbursement rates, claims adjudication processes, and provider network relationships across multiple states.
